units.source_text: 且说今上的母后的妹妹栉笥姬自从那天朦胧月夜与源氏公子邂逅之后，

en.t: Now, from the time when Kushige Princess, the younger sister of the Emperor's mother, happened to meet Prince Genji on that misty moonlit night,
she kept thinking of him constantly.

units.source_text: 她的父亲右大臣说：“这也很好。

en.t: Her father, the Minister of the Right, said, "That would be very good too.

units.source_text: 他新近丧失了那位高贵的夫人，我就把这女儿嫁给他，有何不可？”

en.t: He has recently lost that noble lady, so what would be wrong with my giving this daughter to him in marriage?"

units.source_text: 但母后大不以为然，她说：“送她入宫，地位可以更高，有什么不好呢？”

en.t: But the Empress Mother strongly disagreed and said, "If she is sent into the palace, her rank can become even higher. What is wrong with that?"

units.source_text: 便竭力劝她去当朱雀帝的后宫。

en.t: So she did everything she could to persuade her to enter Emperor Suzaku's inner court.
